sourceHashReview.scope: Re-ran the existing Market success browser flow against current worktree sources; no product source was changed by this run. Seven demo data responses remain scoped to market.success and six mutations ran only against isolated in-memory MSW state.

scenario.note: Chromium rendered 20 Market routes in the local SPA preview and exercised all 22 Market operation IDs (16 GETs plus 6 scoped alert/watchlist writes). Seven source-backed GETs used demo fixtures only in market.success; default unconfigured-source handlers still return documented HTTP 503. All six writes reached the local MSW service worker, returned contract statuses and changed only isolated in-memory fixtures. 2 Playwright net::ERR_ABORTED callbacks were paired by request sequence with successful service-worker 204 DELETE responses and rendered-state assertions; no unmatched API request failure or external API origin was observed. This is local fixture/UI evidence, not backend, staging or user acceptance.
